systems.system: Government-operator agreed mobile data tariff (GETESA, GECOMSA, MUNI)
systems.country_label: mobile data package cut from 15 FCFA per megabyte to 1 FCFA per megabyte, effective 1 September 2022; agreed tariff the Vice-President says operators must respect on pain of licence withdrawal
systems.owner: Government of Equatorial Guinea with GETESA, GECOMSA, MUNI, GITGE, ORTEL

note: The per-megabyte figure is a government-agreed tariff ceiling, not an ordinary standing retail plan or per-GB average; no income share stated.
